mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpSoUniformDetailPopHdList*/ SELECT A.BUYER AS HD_BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER) AS HD_BUYER_NAME, A.ST_NO AS HD_ST_NO, A.ADD_USER_ID AS HD_ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.ADD_USER_ID) AS HD_ADD_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.ADD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS HD_ADD_DATE, A.B_CONFIRM_STATUS AS HD_B_CONFIRM_STATUS, A.B_CONFIRM_USER_ID AS HD_B_CONFIRM_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.B_CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS HD_B_CONFIRM_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.B_CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS HD_B_CONFIRM_DATE, A.B_CONFIRM_NOTE AS HD_B_CONFIRM_NOTE, A.A_CONFIRM_STATUS AS HD_A_CONFIRM_STATUS, A.A_CONFIRM_USER_ID AS HD_A_CONFIRM_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.A_CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS HD_A_CONFIRM_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.A_CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS HD_A_CONFIRM_DATE, A.A_CONFIRM_NOTE AS HD_A_CONFIRM_NOTE, A.S_CONFIRM_STATUS AS HD_S_CONFIRM_STATUS, A.S_CONFIRM_USER_ID AS HD_S_CONFIRM_USER_ID, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.S_CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS HD_S_CONFIRM_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.S_CONFIRM_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS HD_S_CONFIRM_DATE, A.S_CONFIRM_NOTE AS HD_S_CONFIRM_NOTE, A.B_CONFIRM_STATUS || A.A_CONFIRM_STATUS || A.S_CONFIRM_STATUS AS HD_CONFIRM_STATUS, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'ST01' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{buyer} AND CODE = #{st_user_id} AND FLAG = 'Y') AS HD_APRV_YN FROM KEP_BUYER_ST_POHD A WHERE 1=1 AND BUYER = #{buyer} AND ST_NO = #{st_no}

/*selectMasterMpSoUniformDetailPopList*/
SELECT X.BUYER, X.ST_NO, X.ST_SEQ, X.STATUS, DECODE (X.STATUS, 'GC', '생산입고완료', 'GP', '생산부분입고', 'SB', '협력사 반려', 'SC', '협력사 결재', 'MB', '운영사 반려', 'MC', '운영사 결재', 'BB', '고객사 반려', 'BC', '고객사 결재', 'BS', '고객사 상신', 'X', '상태 확인 필요' ) AS STATUS_TEXT, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.DESCRIPTION, X.SPECIFICATION, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.ITEM_QTY, X.REQ_NOTE FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.ST_NO, A.ST_SEQ, CASE WHEN A.ITEM_QTY = A.GR_QTY THEN 'GC' --생산입고완료 WHEN B.S_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'Y' AND A.GR_QTY != 0 THEN 'GP' --생산부분입고 WHEN B.S_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'R' THEN 'SB' --협력사 반려 WHEN B.S_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'Y' AND A.GR_QTY = 0 THEN 'SC' --협력사 결재 WHEN B.A_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'R' THEN 'MB' --운영사 반려 WHEN B.A_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 'MC' --운영사 결재 WHEN B.B_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'R' THEN 'BB' --고객사 반려 WHEN B.B_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'Y' THEN 'BC' --고객사 결재 WHEN B.B_CONFIRM_STATUS = 'N' THEN 'BS' --고객사 상신 ELSE 'X' END AS STATUS, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.REQ_NOTE FROM KEP_BUYER_ST_PODT A, KEP_BUYER_ST_POHD B WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.ST_NO = B.ST_NO AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.ST_NO = #{st_no} ) X ORDER BY X.ST_SEQ
